title_sq: Ne Yzberisht, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!!
description_sq: Ne Yzberisht, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim te nje pallati me 8 kate te pajisur me ashensor, si dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 136 m2 nga te cilat 112.34 m2 siperfaqe neto. Organizohet nga korriori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon. Orientimi i prones eshte perendim. Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar ne menyre komode, i investuar me sistem kaldaje dhe i pajisur gjithashtu edhe me kondicioner. Prona posedon edhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra 1.700.000 Leke te reja. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: In Yzberisht, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, Ideal for Residence or Investment!!!
description_en: In Yzberisht, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, Ideal for Residence or Investment!!! The property is located on the 2nd residential floor of an 8-story building equipped with an elevator, and has a gross area of ​​136 m2, of which 112.34 m2 is a net area. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The orientation of the property is west. The apartment is comfortably furnished, equipped with a boiler system and also equipped with air conditioning. The property also has a parking post with an extra price of 1,700,000 new Lek. The apartment has complete and regular mortgage documentation. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
